title: docs(types): cite the 'agenda' retirement's landing commits, not the dead issue numbers (objectui#10701)
body:
Fixes #10701
Clause-②: no (wording only; no accept set, type or behaviour moves)

Dispatched implementation of the `domain:ui` seat 1 claim (comment `5838463073`) on objectui#10701, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`. Wording only: no accepted value, type or runtime behaviour changes.

## Premise, re-measured first

REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/{n}`, 2026-09-25:

| number | objectui | same number in objectstack |
|---|---|---|
| 5740 | 404 | 200, an unrelated service-analytics PR |
| 5784 | 404 | 200, an unrelated stub-driver rename issue |
| 5782 | 404 | 200, an unrelated metadata-protocol PR |
| 5806 | 404 | 200, an unrelated driver-sql integration-test PR |
| controls 5736, 5742, 5778, 5790 | 200 | |

None of the four answers 200 in objectui, so the premise holds. The sister-repo numbers resolve, but to unrelated subjects, so a repo-qualified citation would send a reader to the wrong record. This PR cites the landing commits instead. Both are ancestors of `main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0 for each):

- `b55a34647` feat(types): retire 'agenda' from CalendarViewMode and the zod enum
- `ed8df3e50` feat(types): retire 'agenda' from defaultView on all three declaration faces

## Citation form, site by site

- **The three zod `.describe()` strings** (`CalendarViewSchema.view`, the list-view `calendar` config's `defaultView`, `ObjectCalendarSchema.defaultView`): the pointer is dropped, and they now end `('agenda' was retired)`. That sentence stands alone. These strings ship in `dist` and reach whatever reads the zod `description` at runtime, a reader who has no repository to resolve a bare sha against. No `.describe()` string under `packages/types/src/zod/` carries a commit citation today, so there was no runtime-string precedent to follow.
- **Docblocks and the zod line comment**: they cite the landing commit as a backticked 9-character sha. That is the form published docblocks, changesets and docs already use, for example "landed as `89d7b35a7`" in `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` and "deleted from the repository in `8c5d20455`" in `.changeset/6342-dead-migration-guide-pointers.md`.
- **`schema-reference.md`, the `CalendarViewMode` row**: "retired in `b55a34647` and now fails validation".
- **The two retirement changesets**: the pointer to themselves is dropped. This repo's `@changesets/cli/changelog` is `@changesets/changelog-git`, which prefixes each CHANGELOG entry with the short hash of the commit that ADDED the file (`git log --diff-filter=A`). That is the landing commit, so the released entry already carries `b55a346` / `ed8df3e`. Where the `defaultView` changeset points at the `CalendarViewMode` retirement, it now cites `b55a34647`.
- **The i18n batch changeset** (`4730-retire-dead-locale-key-batch.md`): "labelled a view mode `b55a34647` retired from `CalendarViewMode`".
- **Pending changeset frontmatter is byte-identical.** The sha256 of each frontmatter block is equal before and after, and `check-changeset-overwrite` prints `declared at base` equal to `declares now` for all three. The filenames keep their `5740` / `5784` suffixes: a filename is not a citation, and a rename would read as deleting one declaration and adding another.

## Which sites actually publish: the card's two classes, measured against `dist`

I built `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` and grepped `dist`:

- **Card's "comment-only" sites that do ship.** The `complex.zod.ts` docblocks on `CalendarViewModeSchema` and `CalendarViewSchema` ship in `dist/zod/complex.zod.d.ts` and `.js`. The `objectql.zod.ts` line comment above the calendar config's `defaultView` ships in `dist/zod/objectql.zod.js`, because tsc emits with `removeComments: false`. This is published text, so this PR repairs it along with the rest. All three are the optional adjacent comments the claim's file surface already lists.
- **Card's "published JSDoc" site that does not ship.** Neither the old nor the new pointer in `plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx` appears in `packages/plugin-calendar/dist`. The same docblock's `objectui#8201` is missing too, while a code string from the same file (the `defaultView` input description) is present as the control. The site is repaired anyway because the triage names it, and it is declared comment-only.
- **Result.** After this PR, `@object-ui/types` `dist` contains no `objectui#5740` or `objectui#5784`.

## Census

`git grep -nE 'objectui#5740|objectui#5784|#5740|#5784|#5782|#5806'` over `packages/`, `content/` and `.changeset/` at the base finds 26 lines, all in files the card names. Outside those three roots it finds 0 (control: `#7853` hits 5 files). After this PR there are 0 non-test hits. The 10 lines that remain are docblocks and comments in four test files. Those do not ship and are optional per the triage (see Acceptance notes).

## Changeset

`.changeset/10701-agenda-retirement-citations.md` declares `@object-ui/types: patch` for the `.describe()` wording (precedent: `10084-grid-ceiling-describe.md`). The `plugin-calendar` edit is comment-only, as measured above. This repo's precedent for comment-only `src/` edits is an empty declaration (for example `10159-action-preview-reference-citation.md`). Instead of adding a second file, the new changeset's body says `plugin-calendar` declares no release. `check-changeset-presence` requires one added declaration, and this one satisfies it.

## Pins

`grep -rln "agenda' was retired" packages/` returns only the two zod source files. No test snapshots or reads the old `describe` text, so no pin changed. No ablation was run, because nothing executable changes.

## Verification, all on `045a05c26` (the patch round's re-runs at `f730dc423` are under Acceptance notes)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/`: `Test Files  240 passed (240)`, `Tests  5276 passed (5276)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-calendar/`: `Test Files  46 passed (46)`, `Tests  328 passed (328)`.
- Suites that read the changed markdown as data, taken from `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` (classes `.changeset/**`, `content/docs/**` and `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`): the 15 readers under `scripts/__tests__/` give `Test Files  15 passed (15)`, `Tests  682 passed (682)`. The readers under `packages/types` ran in the 240 above.
- `type-check`: `@object-ui/types` (tsc on the main, examples and test configs) and `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` (after building its dependency closure). Both exit 0.
- Doc gates: `pnpm docs:check-links` prints "Links are valid across 17 scan roots."; `pnpm check:doc-types` prints "Every documented component type is registered."; `pnpm check:doc-fences`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-expression-carriage` and `pnpm check:doc-example-readers` exit 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` is OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` prints `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` prints "5 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)". `pnpm changeset:check` exits 0. `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` prints "No test source names a pending changeset."
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` (report-only): 50 pending changesets name a file this PR touches (the shared `complex.ts` / `objectql.ts` / zod files and `schema-reference.md`). I read them against the diff. No pending changeset quotes the changed text, and the two retirement changesets' closing sentences about the `describe` strings stay true.
- `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only): 3 files modified, each its case 2 (a deliberate prose correction), with declarations unchanged.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config --format json`) over the five touched source files: 5 files, 0 errors, 49 pre-existing warnings, none on an edited line. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so a comment or string diff cannot change another file's result.
- NOT MEASURED: `check-doc-snippet-types` and `check-doc-example-types`. Reason: both exit 2 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (they need a 34-package scoped build). They type-check code fences, and the only doc edit here is a table cell.

## Acceptance notes

- **`objectui#5783`, folded in the PM patch round (head `f730dc423`).** It also answers 404 (control: `#5781` answers 200), and it was in a changeset this PR already edits, so the seat extended the claim's surface to that one pointer. `.changeset/4730-retire-dead-locale-key-batch.md` line 7 now reads `` `calendar.agenda` included). `` with no replacement citation, as a single hunk `@@ -7 +7 @@`. The frontmatter sha256 is unchanged (`57e32eec…`). The patch round re-ran control bytes, changeset presence / `changeset:check` / claims / overwrite / pending literals, and the two `scripts/__tests__` suites that read `.changeset/**` (2 files / 44 tests): all exit 0. The one residual is the header docblock of `dead-key-batch-retired-4730.test.ts`, which does not ship and sits with the other comment-only test sites below.
- The docblocks and comments in `calendar-view-mode-agenda-retired.test.ts`, `default-view-agenda-retired.test.ts`, `dead-key-batch-retired-4730.test.ts` and `scalarKeysAreDeclaredAndHonoured-8201.test.ts` still cite the dead numbers. They do not ship and are optional per the triage.
- The card's published/comment-only split was wrong in both directions (see above). A `dist` grep settles that classification for future cards of this class.
